claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Dipivefrine is a lipophilic epinephrine prodrug that is rapidly hydrolyzed to epinephrine; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to show little to no selective cytotoxicity, with any weak antiproliferative effect attributable to non-specific adrenergic/catecholamine stress or prodrug hydrolysis rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
